linux_pty: Verified by grepping the Go module cache copy of golang.org/x/sys@v0.41.0 (GOMODCACHE=/root/go/pkg/mod). All names present in v0.41.0. Constants (unix.*, from unix/zerrors_linux_amd64.go): `unix.TIOCSPTLCK` = 0x40045431 (line 490), `unix.TIOCGPTN` = 0x80045430 (line 449), `unix.TIOCSWINSZ` = 0x5414 (line 495). Function: `unix.IoctlSetWinsize(fd int, req uint, value *Winsize) error` — defined in unix/ioctl_unsigned.go:39 (the variant compiled for linux/amd64; a signed-req variant exists in ioctl_signed.go for other arches). Type: `unix.Winsize` (unix/ztypes_linux.go) = struct{ Row uint16; Col uint16; Xpixel uint16; Ypixel uint16 }. IMPORTANT: the SysProcAttr fields named in the spec (Setsid, Setctty, Ctty) are NOT in x/sys/unix — they are fields of `syscall.SysProcAttr` in the Go standard library (verified in /usr/local/go/src/syscall/exec_linux.go): `Setsid bool`, `Setctty bool`, `Ctty int`. So pty_linux.go uses x/sys/unix for the ioctls/Winsize and the stdlib os/exec Cmd.SysProcAttr (*syscall.SysProcAttr) for Setsid/Setctty/Ctty. Idiomatic open/unlock/getptn can use /dev/ptmx with unix.IoctlSetPointerInt(fd, unix.TIOCSPTLCK, 0) to unlock and unix.IoctlGetInt(fd, unix.TIOCGPTN) to get the slave number — both helpers exist in v0.41.0 (ioctl_unsigned.go).

esbuild_css: Read web/build.mjs: it bundles entry src/main.tsx -> dist/app.js with bundle:true, loader {'.css':'css'}, and dist/app.css is produced from the CSS reached through the import graph. src/main.tsx line 3 does `import './styles.css';`, which is why styles.css becomes app.css. Because esbuild's bundler resolves bare node_modules specifiers and concatenates all CSS reachable from the JS entry into the single app.css, the MINIMAL and correct change requires NO edit to build.mjs itself. Pick one: (a) add `@import '@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css';` as the first line of web/src/styles.css; or (b) add `import '@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css';` in web/src/main.tsx immediately before the existing `import './styles.css';`. Either routes the xterm stylesheet into dist/app.css through the existing pipeline. Do NOT add it as a second esbuild entryPoint — that would emit a separate output file rather than bundling into app.css, contradicting the spec. The only build.mjs-adjacent prerequisite is adding @xterm/xterm (and @xterm/addon-fit) to package.json dependencies so the specifier resolves. (This is a recommendation; per task I did not modify any files.)
